meta.name: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
meta.description: A new mystery unfolds at Unicorn Academy as long-buried secrets begin to surface, threatening the very balance of Unicorn Island. As Sophia and her friends return for another year, they are drawn into a dangerous quest filled with hidden powers, unexpected betrayals, and dark forces growing stronger in the shadows. With every step, the stakes rise, pushing the riders to their limits. Packed with magic, suspense, and emotional twists, this chapter promises a thrilling adventure where not everything is as it seems, and every secret could change their destiny forever.

videos.title: Un-Welcome Back
videos.overview: Back at the academy, Sophia wrestles with her guilt about the past as a dazzling Fairy Tiara sparks a quest for six gems to defend the island.

videos.title: The Fairy Gemstones
videos.overview: Valentina tells the tale of how unicorn magic began as the crew finds a map showing where the gems are, pointing to Whispering Willows and Prism Beach.

videos.title: Sneaky Snookers
videos.overview: With the next Fairy Gemstone on the line, an intense training game against the Rubies turns dangerous — and the Sapphires test how far they'll go to win.

videos.title: Sick and Fired
videos.overview: While Val's sick in bed, the crew sets out on a swashbuckling quest up Mount Equus that brings grim illusions, forcing the Sapphires to trust each other.

videos.title: The Grirnorian Gambit
videos.overview: Drawn into Grimoria in search of the final gem, the Sapphires face dark enchantments and a leadership clash that puts their unicoms and mission at risk.

videos.title: Big Trouble
videos.overview: Wildstars brush with grim magic brings a healer with a familiar face, while a hurtful betrayal leaves Sophia with a choice that could change everything.

videos.title: The Solaira Festival
videos.overview: With the Solaira Festival afoot, Sophia braves dark magic and a secret alliance to save her friends as Serena's spellbinding show puts everyone in peril.

videos.title: The Fairy Tiara
videos.overview: While Serena and Ravenzella battle for the Fairy Tiara, the Sapphires leam its true power. Is their bond the key to restoring Unicorn Island's magic?

videos.title: Winged Wonders
videos.overview: After a mysterious earthquake strikes Unicorn Academy, startling visions of a legendary unicorn send Sophia and her friends searching for answers.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: The Sapphires must take care of armaditto pups amidst a heat wave — but the sensitive creatures run wild as new revelations spark fiery frustrations.

videos.title: Tale of the Vampicorn
videos.overview: As the crew settles in for a night of camping, Rory entertains everyone with spooky stories — and Ava keeps sneaking off to see her new friend Zaya.

videos.title: Forced Friendly Fun
videos.overview: The Sapphires travel to Fate Fairy Island to uncover the truth behind the mythical Skywind. As danger grows, can they trust their new Grimorian ally?
